page_title: TOU 3-6 PSG | Toulouse v PSG 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
90+1' 3 - 6 Goal! Santiago Hidalgo tees up Alexis Vossah (Toulouse) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 3:6.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' 2 - 6 Yann Gboho (Toulouse) has a great chance inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
88' Shots on target – 4:8.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aron Donnum (Toulouse) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' The ball goes behind for a corner. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

80' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt. Now PSG have a corner.
79' Substitution. Dayann Methalie walks off the pitch and Seny Koumbassa (Toulouse) comes on as a substitute.

78' 1 - 6 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Joao Neves (PSG) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the top right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Guillaume Restes, so the score changes to 1:6.

76' A nice pass finds Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic low shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Lucas Chevalier pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
75' The manager makes a subsitution with Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) coming on for Bradley Barcola.
75' Joao Neves (PSG) brings his opponent down. Eric Wattellier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Frank Magri will be replaced by Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse).
70' Problems for Luis Enrique as Ousmane Dembele is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Goncalo Ramos (PSG) replaces him.
69' The game is interrupted now, Ousmane Dembele (PSG) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
68' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from PSG.
66' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post.
65' Toulouse win a corner.
65' Toulouse take a short corner kick.
64' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) makes a slide tackle, but referee Eric Wattellier blows for a foul.
63' Mario Sauer will be replaced by Alexis Vossah (Toulouse).
63' Djibril Sidibe goes off the pitch and Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) comes on.
63' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Rasmus Nicolaisen walks off the pitch to be replaced by Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
63' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) replaces Desire Doue.
60' Total attempts – 7:11.
55' The ball goes out of play. Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
55' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Toulouse force their opponents to concede a corner.
51' 1 - 5 Goal! Guillaume Restes gets a hand on the penalty from Ousmane Dembele (PSG), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
51' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
50' The PSG players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
50' Referee Eric Wattellier makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for PSG. Let’s see what happens!
50' Bradley Barcola (PSG) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
48' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for PSG.

47' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Achraf Hakimi (PSG) after he collected a pass and unleashed his low drive. The ball was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper made an easy save. PSG will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
47' PSG failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) replacing Vitinha.
46' Substitution. Nuno Mendes will be replaced by Willian Pacho (PSG).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+9' The end of the first half.

45+8' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the middle of the goal. Lucas Chevalier anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and just stays where he is to stop his effort.
45+8' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+7' Toulouse will get another bite of the cherry as the referee indicates the penalty must be taken again!
45+6' Frank Magri (Toulouse) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom left corner, but it's not enough to beat Lucas Chevalier who easily stops the effort.
45+6' Frank Magri (Toulouse) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+6' The referee points to the penalty spot. Toulouse are awarded a penalty kick!
45+4' The fouls committed statistics – 5:4.
45+2' PSG have a corner.
45+1' A nice individual effort by Vitinha (PSG) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender. The ball is out of play and PSG manage to earn a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
40' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Eric Wattellier signals that there was no offside and the goal stands! The Toulouse players celebrate.
39' The Toulouse players halt their celebrations as referee Eric Wattellier makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
37' 1 - 4 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:4.
37' The ball goes out of play and Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
35' PSG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
35' 0:4 – this is the current number of shots on target.
31' 0 - 4 Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes the penalty and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom right corner!
31' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is going to take the penalty!
30' The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to PSG!
29' Nuno Mendes (PSG) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the bottom right corner, but Guillaume Restes keeps it out with an amazing save.
29' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
27' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) tries to find Joao Neves, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
26' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle as Aron Donnum (Toulouse) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
24' PSG are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
23' Ball possession – 23:77.
19' Desire Doue (PSG) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
17' Bradley Barcola (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

14' 0 - 3 What a GOAL that is! Joao Neves (PSG) showed great determination to get to the ball inside the box and acrobatically launched himself into the air and produced a scissor kick of the highest quality to leave Guillaume Restes helpless. He makes it 0:3.
14' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to PSG.
13' Great teamplay by PSG as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
11' How did he miss! The cross loops over the keeper leaving Joao Neves (PSG) with an empty net, but somehow he heads the ball well wide of the right post from close range.
9' 0 - 2 Bradley Barcola (PSG) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
7' 0 - 1 GOAL! But maybe a bit lucky, as a miscued scissor kick inside the box from Joao Neves (PSG) squirms into the net somehow. That changes the score to 0:1.
6' Mario Sauer (Toulouse) is penalised for holding. Eric Wattellier signals a set piece. PSG are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
6' The free kick from close range, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Toulouse have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Toulouse will kick the game off.
Eric Wattellier will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
